ModMetaData.name: Tidy Threads
ModMetaData.author: josh9817
ModMetaData.description:
Dressers store 20 pieces of apparel and wardrobes store 30. Both only accept apparel and default to Critical priority, which you can lower per piece of furniture.
Every dresser becomes apparel storage. A wardrobe is added: Vanilla Furniture Expanded's when that mod is active, otherwise this mod's own.
Removing this mod from a save is not supported: uninstall your dressers and wardrobes first.
Requires RimWorld 1.6, Harmony and Adaptive Storage Framework. No DLC required.
